title: Korarrun Sama
intro: Wani abu mai ban mamaki yana tsaye a kan mahaɗar halitta da ƙin yarda. Labarinsu yana nuna girman kai mara misaltuwa da kuma rashin bin umarnin Allah. Zabinsu yana ta yawo a cikin kowace tsara, yana zama jarrabawa ga kowace rai da aka haifa a cikin wannan duniyar. Za ku iya gano wannan maƙiyi na har abada?
clues: Na kasance a wurin wani lamari mai muhimmanci a sararin samaniya, lokacin da aka samar da wani sabon halitta daga yumbu aka kuma ba shi rai ta hanyar Numfashin Mai Rahama.
Ni kaina an halicce ni ne daga wani abu mai kama da wuta guda ɗaya, ba kamar ƙura ba.
An ba ni umarni wanda na ɗauka a ƙarƙashin ofishina.
Girman kai ya cika ni, kuma na ƙi bin wannan umarni da ƙarfi.
An ba ni jinkiri har sai an sanya ranar da aka ƙayyade, domin in ci gaba da manufar da na ayyana ta na yaudarar wasu.
Ni ne maƙiyin duk wanda ke tafiya a duniya, ina raɗa musu ƙarya ina kuma jan su daga hanya madaidaiciya.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Ya ƙi yin sujada a gaban Adamu
An ƙera ɗan maraƙi na zinariya don bauta
Ya jagoranci adawa da mushrikai a Makkah
trial.answer: Ya ƙi yin sujada a gaban Adamu

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An ba da jinkiri har zuwa Ranar Sakamako
An nutsar da shi tare da rundunar a cikin teku
Duniya ta haɗiye ta tare da taskoki
An canza shi zuwa birai saboda karya dokar Asabar
An ƙone ta da duwatsu da aka jefa daga sama
outcome.answer: An ba da jinkiri har zuwa Ranar Sakamako

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ سُلْطَـٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verse: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord. (16:99)
